dsh.customCli.title: Custom dsh kernel
dsh.customCli.desc: Use a dsh kernel from a directory you specify (your own build or a modified fork). Two layouts are recognized: package source root (with apps/cli/lib/bin.js) / npm install directory.
dsh.customCli.placeholder: Enter or choose a dsh directory…
dsh.customCli.appliedWithPending: ✓ Active — version {{version}} · {{count}} running session(s) marked for restart
dsh.customCli.overrideHint: A custom kernel is active; installs below only write to the data root. Clear the custom directory to switch back.
dsh.extRestartHint: Plugin enable/disable changes take effect after restarting the dsh session process (next session or reopen the current one).
dsh.title: DSH kernel version management
dsh.desc: Maintains only ~/.my-harness-desktop/dsh. Pick a version to install (newer = upgrade, older = downgrade); the desktop doesn't touch PATH's dsh.
dshModels.title: DSH model config
dshModels.desc: dsh's provider = LLM adapter route (llm-pi-ai's providers dictionary, fully custom). Edit each route's connection facts (apiKey/api/baseURL) and models (id/name/contextWindow/maxTokens).
dshModels.apiKeyDesc: The key literal is written per provider into dsh's credential store (~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml) and read directly by the dsh runtime. It is not injected as a process environment variable nor written into settings.yaml/cordis.yml.
dshModels.name: name
dshModels.importDesc: Paste JSON (single or array of {provider, apiKeyEnv?, displayName?, api?, baseURL?, models}): existing provider is overwritten, otherwise appended.
dshModels.importInvalid: Invalid JSON or wrong shape (expected {provider, models:[]})
dsh.appliedWithPending: ✓ Active — version {{version}} · {{count}} running session(s) marked for restart
dshModels.discoverEmpty: Click "Scan models" to list all models on this endpoint
dshModels.discoverUseConfigured: Listing not supported · use {{count}} configured models instead
dshModels.devRoleHint: Some OpenAI-compatible gateways only accept the system role; the kernel sends developer by default for reasoning models and gets rejected with 400 — tick this to fall back to system.
dsh.routeEmptyModels: dsh route “{{provider}}” has no models: add at least one model, or remove the route — an empty route makes the dsh runtime reject the whole llm-pi-ai section, breaking every other provider too
dsh.routeEmptyModelId: dsh route “{{provider}}” has an empty model id: fill it in or remove that model
dshModels.exportFailed: Could not export the model config: {{detail}} (this host may not support save dialogs)
dsh.noInstallHint: No kernel version is installed yet. Once installed, the current version and available updates appear here.
